name: glb-designer-stage7d
description: Asset Studio Stage 7d — slot-constraint authoring for configurable exports. Build a 2-slot design (Top: Glass/Oak + Legs: Steel/Wood), author 'Top:Glass requires Legs:Steel', export as a user configurable product (asserting the product carries the mapped SlotConstraint). Open it in the existing ConfiguratorDialog seeded on Oak top + Wood legs (no rule active), then pick Glass top → assert Legs auto-resolve/lock to Steel (the requires flips + holds the dependent slot). Reset to Wood legs first then Glass top → assert the clamp still resolves Legs → Steel (order-independent). Finally, re-seed the design and author a CONTRADICTION (Glass both requires AND excludes Steel) → assert export is BLOCKED with a toast naming the conflict + the product is NOT registered.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_user_products') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUserConfigurableProducts?.([]); s.setQualityTier?.('performance'); })()

steps.name: seed-two-slot-design
steps.comment: A table with a Top slot (Glass vs Oak boards) + a Legs slot (Steel vs Wood posts). Each option is its own PartGroup; a shared apron is loose base geometry.
steps.eval: (function(){ const legs=[[-0.5,-0.3],[0.5,-0.3],[-0.5,0.3],[0.5,0.3]]; const parts=[{id:'apron',kind:'box',position:[0,0.68,0],size:[1.1,0.06,0.7],color:'#7d6240'}]; const steel=[]; const wood=[]; legs.forEach((c,i)=>{ const st='st'+i, wd='wd'+i; parts.push({id:st,kind:'cylinder',position:[c[0],0.34,c[1]],size:[0.05,0.68,0.05],color:'#b8bcc0'}); parts.push({id:wd,kind:'box',position:[c[0],0.34,c[1]],size:[0.06,0.68,0.06],color:'#8a6a45'}); steel.push(st); wood.push(wd); }); parts.push({id:'glass',kind:'box',position:[0,0.75,0],size:[1.2,0.02,0.8],color:'#cfe6ea'}); parts.push({id:'oak',kind:'box',position:[0,0.75,0],size:[1.2,0.04,0.8],color:'#9a7b50'}); window.__glbDesigner.setSpec({ sourceScale:1, meshOverrides:{}, parts, partGroups:[ {id:'g-glass',name:'Glass top',partIds:['glass']}, {id:'g-oak',name:'Oak top',partIds:['oak']}, {id:'g-steel',name:'Steel legs',partIds:steel}, {id:'g-wood',name:'Wood legs',partIds:wood} ] }); })()

steps.name: author-and-export
steps.comment: Top: Glass(default)/Oak · Legs: Steel(default)/Wood. Author 'Glass REQUIRES Steel' as a per-option rule, then bake → a user configurable product carrying the mapped SlotConstraint.

steps.name: assert-product-with-constraint
steps.comment: The exported product registers with a Top + Legs slot and the mapped requires constraint (Glass → Steel).
steps.failMessage: exported product should register with a Top+Legs pair of slots and one requires constraint (Glass → Steel)

steps.name: open-configurator-oak-wood
steps.comment: Seed the dialog on Oak top + Wood legs (no rule active) so the flip is observable when Glass is picked.
steps.eval: (function(){ const st=window.__store.getState(); const p=st.userConfigurableProducts[0]; st.setConfiguratorEditSpec(JSON.stringify({productId:p.id, selections:{Top:'g-oak', Legs:'g-wood'}})); st.setConfiguratorOpen(true); })()

steps.name: assert-initial-oak-wood
steps.comment: With Oak selected the requires is dormant → Wood legs stay the active pick (no forced flip yet).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=t=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith(t)); const oak=btn('Oak'), wood=btn('Wood'), steel=btn('Steel'); if(!oak||!wood||!steel) throw new Error('option buttons missing'); if(!oak.className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Oak should be the active top'); if(!wood.className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Wood should be the active legs before the rule fires'); if(steel.className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Steel should NOT be active yet'); })()

steps.name: pick-glass-top
steps.comment: Pick the Glass top — clampConfig's requires must auto-resolve Legs → Steel.
steps.eval: (function(){ const glass=[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith('Glass')); if(!glass) throw new Error('Glass option missing'); glass.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-legs-flipped-to-steel
steps.comment: Glass now active AND the requires flipped Legs → Steel (Wood no longer active).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=t=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith(t)); const glass=btn('Glass'), steel=btn('Steel'), wood=btn('Wood'); if(!glass.className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Glass should be the active top'); if(!steel.className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('requires did not flip Legs to Steel'); if(wood.className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Wood should no longer be active'); })()

steps.name: assert-legs-locked
steps.comment: Try to pick Wood while Glass is selected — the requires re-clamps it straight back to Steel (locked).

steps.name: assert-still-steel
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=t=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith(t)); if(!btn('Steel').className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Legs should stay locked to Steel while Glass is chosen'); if(btn('Wood').className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Wood pick should have been re-clamped away'); })()

steps.name: reset-wood-first-then-glass
steps.comment: Order-independence: reset to Oak+Wood, pick Wood legs FIRST, then Glass top → the clamp still resolves Legs → Steel.

steps.name: assert-order-independent
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=t=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith(t)); if(!btn('Glass').className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('Glass should be active'); if(!btn('Steel').className.includes('btn-accent')) throw new Error('picking Wood-then-Glass should still resolve Legs to Steel'); })()

steps.name: re-seed-two-slot-design
steps.eval: (function(){ const legs=[[-0.5,-0.3],[0.5,-0.3],[-0.5,0.3],[0.5,0.3]]; const parts=[{id:'apron',kind:'box',position:[0,0.68,0],size:[1.1,0.06,0.7],color:'#7d6240'}]; const steel=[]; const wood=[]; legs.forEach((c,i)=>{ const st='st'+i, wd='wd'+i; parts.push({id:st,kind:'cylinder',position:[c[0],0.34,c[1]],size:[0.05,0.68,0.05],color:'#b8bcc0'}); parts.push({id:wd,kind:'box',position:[c[0],0.34,c[1]],size:[0.06,0.68,0.06],color:'#8a6a45'}); steel.push(st); wood.push(wd); }); parts.push({id:'glass',kind:'box',position:[0,0.75,0],size:[1.2,0.02,0.8],color:'#cfe6ea'}); parts.push({id:'oak',kind:'box',position:[0,0.75,0],size:[1.2,0.04,0.8],color:'#9a7b50'}); window.__glbDesigner.setSpec({ sourceScale:1, meshOverrides:{}, parts, partGroups:[ {id:'g-glass',name:'Glass top',partIds:['glass']}, {id:'g-oak',name:'Oak top',partIds:['oak']}, {id:'g-steel',name:'Steel legs',partIds:steel}, {id:'g-wood',name:'Wood legs',partIds:wood} ] }); })()

steps.name: author-contradiction
steps.comment: Glass both REQUIRES and EXCLUDES Steel — a contradiction. Export must block before baking.

steps.name: assert-export-blocked
steps.comment: The export returned null (blocked), no new product registered, and a toast names the conflict.
steps.eval: (function(){ if(window.__badResult!==null) throw new Error('contradiction export should resolve to null, got '+window.__badResult); const after=window.__store.getState().userConfigurableProducts.length; if(after!==window.__prodBefore) throw new Error('a contradictory product must NOT be registered'); const txt=(document.body.textContent||''); if(!/rules conflict|requires and excludes/i.test(txt)) throw new Error('expected a toast naming the rule conflict'); })()
